template.description: HGDB（瀚高数据库 V9，基于 PostgreSQL 14 内核，完全兼容标准 PG 系统视图）巡检模板。通过 JDBC (org.postgresql.Driver) 连接，巡检 SQL 直接使用 pg_stat_* / pg_settings / pg_locks 等标准 PG 视图

chapters.description: 版本 / 启动时间 / 运行时长

queries.query_sql: SELECT version()
SELECT pg_postmaster_start_time() AS start_time, now()-pg_postmaster_start_time() AS uptime
queries.query_description_zh: 实例启动时间与运行时长

chapters.description: 连接状态分布 / 活跃会话清单

queries.query_sql: SELECT state, count(*) AS conn_count FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state ORDER BY conn_count DESC
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity

chapters.description: 全部运行时参数 / 关键内存参数

queries.query_sql: SELECT name, setting, unit, category, short_desc, context, source FROM pg_settings ORDER BY category, name
SHOW shared_buffers

chapters.description: 库大小 / 写入器统计 / 库级统计

queries.query_sql: SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) AS size_pretty, pg_database_size(datname) AS size_bytes FROM pg_database ORDER BY size_bytes DESC
SELECT * FROM pg_stat_bgwriter

SELECT datname, numbackends, xact_commit, xact_rollback, blks_read, blks_hit, tup_returned, tup_fetched, tup_inserted, tup_updated, tup_deleted, conflicts, temp_files, temp_bytes, deadlocks FROM pg_stat_database

chapters.description: 表体积 / 表统计 / 索引使用

queries.query_sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, pg_total_relation_size(relid) AS total_bytes, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50
queries.query_description_zh: 用户表体积 TOP50（pg_total_relation_size，含索引/TOAST）
queries.query_description_en: Top 50 user tables by total size

queries.query_sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, last_vacuum, last_autovacuum, last_analyze, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables
queries.query_description_zh: 表存活/死元组与清理/分析时间

queries.query_sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, indexrelname, idx_scan, idx_tup_read, idx_tup_fetch FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
SELECT locktype, database::regclass AS db, relation::regclass AS rel, pid, mode, granted FROM pg_locks
SELECT a.pid, a.usename, a.query, l.locktype, l.mode FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE NOT l.granted

chapters.description: 角色 / 密码策略 / 访问控制

queries.query_sql: SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolreplication FROM pg_roles ORDER BY rolname
SHOW password_encryption
SELECT type, database, user_name, address, auth_method FROM pg_hba_file_rules
SHOW wal_level
SHOW archive_mode
SELECT archived_count, failed_count, last_archived_wal, last_archived_time, stats_reset FROM pg_stat_archiver
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, sync_state, sent_lsn, write_lsn, flush_lsn, replay_lsn FROM pg_stat_replication
